items.title: Trump Renames Lake Ontario, Canada Responds
items.content:
President Trump’s decision to rename Lake Ontario to Lake America is making waves on both sides of the border.
Bloomberg News Shaquille Omari looks at how Canada and tech companies are responding. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.en: President Trump's decision to rename Lake Ontario to Lake America has sparked reactions in Canada and from tech companies, according to Bloomberg News. The move has drawn attention and is being monitored across the border.

items.title: Lutnick to Review Pentagon Deals Involving Cerberus Firms
items.content: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has been chosen by the Department of Defense to review any transactions between the Pentagon and companies associated with Cerberus Capital Management, according to a US official.

summaries.zh: 美国商务部部长霍华德·卢特尼克被国防部指定，审查五角大楼与 Cerberus 资本管理相关公司之间的任何交易。据美国官员透露，此举旨在监督涉及 Cerberus 资本管理公司的五角大楼相关交易。
summaries.en: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has been appointed by the Department of Defense to examine Pentagon transactions involving companies linked to Cerberus Capital Management, per a US official. The review aims to oversee deals with Cerberus-affiliated firms.

items.title: Jobs Surge Raises Odds of September Fed Hike
items.content: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Seaport Research Partner Managing Director & Chief Equity Strategist Jonathan Golub says a stronger-than-expected US jobs report reinforces the case for the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, despite President Donald Trump’s calls for lower borrowing costs. Golub also says to hosts Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason that his bigger concern is longer-term bond yields as heavy AI investment and government borrowing compete for capital. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Seaport Research Partner Managing Director & Chief Equity Strategist Jonathan Golub says a stronger-than-expected US jobs report reinforces the case for the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, despite President Donald Trump’s calls for lower borrowing costs. Golub also says to hosts Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason that his bigger concern is longer-term bond yields as heavy AI investment and government borrowing compete for capital. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 根据彭博报道，海港研究首席策略师乔纳森·古尔布表示，美国就业数据超预期强化了美联储加息的可能性，尽管特朗普呼吁降低借贷成本。他更关注长期债券收益率，因人工智能投资和政府借贷竞争资本。（来源：彭博）
summaries.en: A stronger-than-expected US jobs report strengthens the case for the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates in September, despite President Trump's calls for lower borrowing costs. Seaport Research's Jonathan Golub also highlights concerns about rising long-term bond yields due to heavy AI investment and government borrowing competing for capital. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: The Hidden Cost of America’s Bureaucracy
items.content: In her new book The Time Tax, Atlantic staff writer Annie Lowrey examines how paperwork, delays and administrative hurdles consume Americans’ time and can make government benefits and services harder to access. Joining Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend, Lowrey argues those burdens fall disproportionately on lower-income Americans and says simpler applications, better data sharing and streamlined tax filing could help reduce the cost. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 《美国官僚体系的隐性成本》一文指出，美国繁杂的文书工作、延误和行政障碍耗费了民众时间，并使政府福利和服务更难获取。作者安妮·洛雷在《大西洋月刊》新书《时间税》中强调，这些负担对低收入群体尤为突出。她建议简化申请流程、改善数据共享和优化税务申报，以降低成本。（来源：彭博）
summaries.en: Annie Lowrey's book *The Time Tax* explores how bureaucracy, including paperwork and delays, consumes Americans' time and hinders access to government benefits. She argues these burdens disproportionately affect lower-income individuals. Lowrey suggests simpler applications, improved data sharing, and streamlined tax filing could mitigate these issues. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: US Strikes Iranian Tankers After Attack on US Warships
items.content: Bloomberg This Weekend has breaking news that US forces struck three Iranian crude carriers after the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launched ballistic missiles toward two US Navy warships, according to US Central Command. The renewed fighting around the Strait of Hormuz adds pressure to shipping and energy markets as President Donald Trump continues to downplay the conflict as something short of war. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Bloomberg This Weekend has breaking news that US forces struck three Iranian crude carriers after the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launched ballistic missiles toward two US Navy warships, according to US Central Command. The renewed fighting around the Strait of Hormuz adds pressure to shipping and energy markets as President Donald Trump continues to downplay the conflict as something short of war. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 根据彭博社报道，美国中央司令部证实，伊朗革命卫队向两艘美国海军军舰发射弹道导弹后，美军击中了三艘伊朗原油运输船。此次冲突发生在霍尔木兹海峡，加剧了航运和能源市场的紧张局势。尽管如此，特朗普总统仍淡化此次冲突，称其并非战争。
summaries.en: US forces struck three Iranian crude oil tankers following an attack by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) on two US Navy warships in the Strait of Hormuz, Central Command confirmed. The IRGC launched ballistic missiles at the US vessels. The renewed hostilities are increasing pressure on global shipping and energy markets. President Trump has described the situation as short of war. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Esper Raises Concern Over Pentagon Leadership Loss
items.content: On Bloomberg This Weekend Former Defense Secretary Mark Esper calls the Pentagon’s polygraph testing of roughly 50 Joint Staff members unprecedented in scale as officials investigate leaks about US munitions stocks. Esper tells hosts Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason that he is less concerned about immediate combat readiness than the institutional impact of leadership turnover and its potential effect on the military’s tradition of an apolitical officer corps. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 前国防部长马克·埃斯珀在彭博周末节目中表示，五角大楼对约50名联合参谋部成员进行测谎，规模前所未有，以调查美国弹药库泄密事件。埃斯珀称，他更关注领导层更迭对军事非政治化传统可能产生的影响，而非眼前的作战能力。来源：彭博。

Esper expressed less concern about immediate combat readiness and more about the institutional impact of leadership turnover, fearing it could undermine the military's apolitical officer corps tradition. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: EU Envoy Urges Maximum Pressure on Russia
items.content: EU Ambassador to the United States Jovita Neliupšienė joins Bloomberg This Weekend and discusses with hosts Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason that Europe must keep supporting Ukraine while applying “maximum pressure” on Moscow because Russia has not changed its war aims. The comments come as US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner visit Moscow before heading to Kyiv in an effort to revive stalled peace negotiations. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 欧盟驻美大使约维塔·内利普谢涅在彭博周末访谈中强调，鉴于俄罗斯并未改变其战争目标，欧洲必须继续支持乌克兰，同时向莫斯科施加“最大压力”。此番言论正值美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳访问莫斯科，随后前往基辅，试图重启停滞的和平谈判之际。（信息来源：彭博）
summaries.en: EU Ambassador Jovita Neliupšienė emphasizes Europe's need to support Ukraine while applying "maximum pressure" on Russia, citing Moscow's unchanged war aims. Her remarks coincide with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner visiting Moscow before Kyiv to revive stalled peace talks. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: AI May Transform How Humans Understand Animals
items.content: Researchers are using AI to analyze vast collections of animal vocalizations, looking for patterns that could help humans better understand how species such as crows communicate. Bloomberg Weekend Senior Writer Morgan Meaker is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says the technology could reshape humans’ relationship with animals, but researchers warn it also raises ethical questions about privacy, exploitation and how those discoveries might be used. (Source: Bloomberg)

Bloomberg Weekend Senior Writer Morgan Meaker is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says the technology could reshape humans’ relationship with animals, but researchers warn it also raises ethical questions about privacy, exploitation and how those discoveries might be used. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 研究人员正利用人工智能分析大量动物发声数据，寻找物种（如乌鸦）交流模式的规律，以帮助人类更好地理解动物。这一技术可能重塑人与动物的关系，但研究机构也提醒，其应用涉及隐私、剥削等伦理问题。
summaries.en: Researchers employ AI to analyze animal vocalizations, seeking patterns to improve human understanding of species like crows. This technology may transform human-animal relationships but raises ethical concerns about privacy, exploitation, and potential misuse of discoveries. The findings could reshape communication insights but require careful consideration of ethical implications. (98 words)

items.title: Singapore Government Won’t Interfere in Decisions on Air India
items.content: The Singapore government said it will not interfere in any decision that Singapore Airlines Ltd. makes in Air India Ltd., which is said to be seeking financial aid from its shareholders.

summaries.en: The Singapore government stated it will not interfere in decisions made by Singapore Airlines Ltd. regarding Air India Ltd., which is reportedly seeking financial assistance from its shareholders.

items.title: Energy Markets Strained by Iran, Ukraine Wars
items.content: Renewed US-Iran fighting and uncertainty over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz are adding pressure to global energy markets, while the threat of mines continues to deter some traffic. Ukraine’s attacks on Russian refineries are compounding tight diesel supplies, creating what Bloomberg News Oil Products Reporter Will Kubzansky describes as a distillates crisis heading into peak demand season. Also joining Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the situation is Bloomberg News Middle East Correspondent Abeer Abu Omar. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: How Women Are Shaping Drag Racing
items.content: Drag racing has outpaced Formula 1, NASCAR and IndyCar on inclusivity, offering a model for sports that still treat women competing at the highest level as a novelty, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Adam Minter says. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Drag racing has outpaced Formula 1, NASCAR and IndyCar on inclusivity, offering a model for sports that still treat women competing at the highest level as a novelty, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Adam Minter says. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Leonardo CEO Mariani Sees Ukraine Unit as Acquisition Outpost
items.content: Leonardo SpA, the Italian state-controlled defense company, is aiming to deepen ties with Ukraine’s fast-growing military-technology sector through its new Kyiv unit, seeking partnership, investment or acquisition opportunities, Chief Executive Officer Lorenzo Mariani said.

The company seeks to leverage the unit as an outpost for future growth opportunities.

items.title: Europe’s Wealth Managers Are Turning Their Backs on Stock Rally
items.content: More European wealth managers have turned pessimistic on the region’s stocks, taking the view that this year’s rally is likely to falter while markets in the US and developing countries power ahead.
items.contentSnippet: More European wealth managers have turned pessimistic on the region’s stocks, taking the view that this year’s rally is likely to falter while markets in the US and developing countries power ahead.
items.creator: Margaryta Kirakosian and Levin Stamm

summaries.zh: 欧洲财富管理机构的股票态度转为悲观。他们认为今年欧洲股市的反弹可能难以持续，而美国和新兴市场将继续领跑。
summaries.en: European wealth managers are increasingly pessimistic about regional stock performance, expecting this year's rally to falter. They anticipate stronger market growth in the U.S. and developing countries.

items.title: Malaysia’s PAS Party Wants Nationwide Gambling License Review
items.content: Parti Islam Se-Malaysia, which leads the country’s main opposition bloc, said the government should review existing gambling licenses and stop giving new ones, its latest effort to curb social ills.
items.contentSnippet: Parti Islam Se-Malaysia, which leads the country’s main opposition bloc, said the government should review existing gambling licenses and stop giving new ones, its latest effort to curb social ills.
items.creator: Kok Leong Chan

summaries.zh: 马来西亚伊斯兰党（PAS）呼吁政府审查现有博彩牌照并停止发放新牌照，以遏制社会问题。该党是该国主要反对派联盟的领导者。
summaries.en: Malaysia’s opposition party, PAS, calls for a review of nationwide gambling licenses and halts new issuances to combat social problems. The move is part of their efforts to address societal issues.

items.title: HK’s Lee Says City to Expand Offshore Yuan Usage in 5-Year Plan
items.content: Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee said the city’s first five-year plan will focus on areas including expanding offshore yuan usage and cross-border investment with the mainland.
items.contentSnippet: Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee said the city’s first five-year plan will focus on areas including expanding offshore yuan usage and cross-border investment with the mainland.
items.creator: Echo Wong

summaries.zh: 香港特首李家超表示，香港首份五年计划将重点拓展离岸人民币使用和与内地的跨境投资。计划旨在推动两地金融合作，促进经济互联互通。
summaries.en: Hong Kong's Chief Executive, John Lee, announced that the city's first five-year plan will prioritize expanding offshore yuan usage and cross-border investment with mainland China. The plan aims to enhance financial integration and economic cooperation between Hong Kong and the mainland.
